name: reviewflow
description: Local-first creator content review, prediction, publishing and retrospective workflow.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @reviewflow/domain && npm run build --workspace @reviewflow/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @reviewflow/domain && npm run test --workspace @reviewflow/desktop && npm run test:renderer-e2e && node scripts/run-python-tests.mjs
scripts.test:renderer-e2e: npm run build --workspace @reviewflow/domain && npm run build --workspace @reviewflow/desktop && npm run test:e2e --workspace @reviewflow/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @reviewflow/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @reviewflow/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
